scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,h5 -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @travel/shared" "npm run dev -w travel-server" "npm run dev -w travel-h5"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel/shared && npm run build -w travel-server && npm run build -w travel-h5
scripts.type-check: npm run build -w @travel/shared && npm run type-check -w travel-h5 && npm run build -w travel-server && npm run type-check:eval -w travel-server
